name: k32-foodbank-store
prompt:
Late afternoon at a food bank's collection centre in Hyderabad: a tidy storeroom with steel shelves opening onto a yard where a small white van stands with its rear doors open. Volunteers in plain green T-shirts carry sealed Munchly cartons, each with its printed product label, from the van and stack them on the shelves. In the foreground the coordinator (the woman in her early thirties in a green T-shirt with a navy lanyard and a white badge, black hair in a bun) stands beside the shelf and holds her phone in both hands at chest height, reading it; the phone's screen shows exactly the app screen in the reference image (a white page headed Pickups with a green card), sharp and upright; she has exactly two arms and two hands, both on the phone, and touches nothing else. On the shelf beside her a sealed Munchly carton faces the camera with its printed label fully readable, and an open carton shows sealed Munchly chips packets and Mango Drink packs. Sealed packets and cartons only: nothing is cooked or served, no pots, plates, ladles or food on plates anywhere. Medium shot, 35 mm, warm late light from the yard, gentle and documentary. Every person has exactly two arms and two hands.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. The cartons are kraft-brown shipping cartons, each carrying one large printed product label exactly like the label in the reference photo: a white sticker with a maroon band reading MUNCHLY MASALA CHIPS (or MUNCHLY MANGO DRINK), the ingredients line, a boxed net quantity and MRP, a boxed BATCH NO, MFG and BEST BEFORE dates, the maker's address, the FSSAI mark, a barcode and a QR code, with a blue storage line at the foot; the label is crisp, straight and legible; no carton carries plain lettering, every carton carries this label. The snack packets are Munchly's own orange chips packets exactly like the reference pack: an orange-to-red gradient with the white MUNCHLY wordmark on a green swoosh and 'Masala Chips' beneath; the Mango Drink packs are small yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango and the word Munchly. No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No number plate. No children.
